Both pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 159 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 166 KB decompressed. CSS stripped before parsing, letters read from each tier__tier block's tier__title, specs from each entry's img alt. Extra tierlists rejected by ROSTER MATCH, never by position: the M+ page's nine unmatched images are the eight dungeon-difficulty blocks (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) plus the Method logo, and the raid page's single unmatched image is the logo. 40 rows per bracket, 0 duplicates, letters confined to the registered 4-band method scale S|A|B|C. All 80 letters byte-identical to stored - nothing merged; snapshots advanced to 2026-08-29 on tonight's fetch. Page self-dates read from the body's 'Last Updated' line: raid 10th August 2026, M+ 13th August 2026 (the M+ list is bylined Tactyks), both unchanged. Era-verified s2 from the body: the raid page says 'the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss' and the M+ page 'dungeon difficulty in Midnight Season 2'; neither page mentions Season 1 at all, and all 40 roster specs including Devourer matched on both. Method carries no published field in the registry, so these self-dates are recorded here rather than written into sources.json - adding a field is registry structure, not an agent-updatable value.

MERGED 6 letters from a genuine upstream rebuild. Upstream frozen for 18 days; both endpoints fetched fine, so this is not our transport. Two plain curls, no headers, no proxy: manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39.026Z) and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 161,191 bytes, returning Last-Modified 'Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT' - the two agree. Per the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest lesson the PAYLOAD was diffed rather than trusted to the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelist categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === 'lowerBound' AND keyRange undefined selects exactly 3 blocks = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, and all 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts are identical to stored at the series' 1-dp stored precision. The melee/ranged blocks were excluded by whitelist rather than by blacklisting 'dungeon', since they are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs. Nothing to merge, so asOf correctly stays at the source's own 2026-08-11 snapshotDate and the coverage date does not move. This is the owner-accepted standing red recorded on the contract row - it clears when WoWMeta re-runs; do not ack it away and do not raise maxAgeDays.

Plain browser-UA GET on the three meta pages (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 70.9 / 41.9 / 40.6 KB. All three still carry the machine-readable <time datetime="2026-08-28T03:00:2xZ"> that the previous run merged - the daily 03:00Z cut for the 29th has not published - so the page is serving the same cut rather than a new one. The payload was diffed rather than trusted to that timestamp: parse anchored on the BARE 'meta-item' class token inside the <a> tag (murlok varies its attribute order, and a strict form silently drops href-first rows), 27 / 7 / 6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, ranks verified contiguous 1..N on each page, and all 40 values are identical to stored at the series' integer precision. Merging them would have re-stamped an unchanged reading with today's date and defeated the staleness gate exactly, so nothing was written and the sources.json snapshot was left at 2026-08-28 to match the cut it describes. All three pages self-identify 'Midnight Season 2 ... Patch 12.1'.

HELD WHOLESALE for a fourth night, same reason as 08-27/08-28: this is a DELIBERATE HOLD, not a fetch failure. All 27 DPS specs requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 retries each: 19 returned real charts and 8 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body (Havoc, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Retribution, Arms, Fury - the documented persistent set, unchanged from the previous two nights). Every one of the 19 reads simc_settings.tier = MID2 (ptr is the string "0", as documented) with chart timestamps 2026-08-26, against 26 stored profiles all on MID1 at 2026-07-08/07-15. Merging the 19 is blocked three independent ways, any one sufficient: SIM_TIER_REQUIRED plus the tier-uniformity invariant forbid a pool holding both MID1 and MID2; fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key and derives its ST/cleave/AoE labels as within-role percentiles, so a partial merge would publish WHICH specs upstream has re-simmed as if it were spec strength; and 19 of 26 rows is past maxRowDropPct 0.25. Merged NOTHING; stored fightProfile values, tiers and dates are byte-identical and the coverage date correctly stays 2026-07-08 rather than being re-stamped. FLAG FOR THE OWNER, unchanged: the eventual landing is a wholesale MID2 adoption and will need a human value_move_ack - the value-move gate has no agent-writable proposal channel.

HELD for a fourth night, but the blocker has CHANGED and the owner should know: coverage is no longer the binding constraint. MID2_Raid.txt is 1.29 MB, Last-Modified 2026-08-29T07:39:40Z, header '12.1.0.69497 Live (hotfix 2026-08-29/69497, git build HEAD f367d1aff1)' - a new build against last night's 6266922349 - and its 'DPS Ranking:' block now carries 41 profiles against 38 last night. Mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed, those reach 22 of the 27 DPS roster specs, up from 19: Devourer Demon Hunter, Havoc Demon Hunter, Arms Warrior and Fury Warrior have arrived, leaving only Balance Druid, Feral Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker and Retribution Paladin absent (the 7 unmapped profiles are tanks - Prot Warrior, Brewmaster, Prot Paladin x2, Vengeance, Blood DK x2). At 22 of 26 stored rows a wholesale adoption is a 15% drop, now UNDER maxRowDropPct 0.25, so the row floor no longer blocks it. What does block it is maxValueMovePct: all 22 overlapping rows move +69% to +135% (Frost DK 137,886 -> 233,250 at the low end, Fury Warrior 109,256 -> 256,860 at the high), and the value-move gate takes only a human value_move_ack or a reviewed local run - there is no agent-writable proposal channel for it. Merging only some of the 22 is separately forbidden: the name 'SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS' is season-agnostic and its ranks are pooled across the family, so leaving 4 MID1 rows standing beside 22 MID2 ones is the mislabel honest typing forbids. MID1_Raid.txt is again a 272-byte in-progress log carrying the same 12.1.0.69497 header, so MID1_Raid.html - the 12.0.7.68974 artefact of 2026-08-08 - remains the source of the stored 26 and is now three weeks old on an old patch. Merged nothing; stored rows byte-identical, coverage date stays 2026-08-08.

All 44 transcribable channels polled via the YouTube RSS endpoint, 0 failures, 15 entries each = 660 videos; media:description parsed alongside each title, which is what settled three of tonight's triage calls at zero transcript cost. The one queued video had its transcript pre-fetched by the deterministic step (transcript-fetch/summary.json attemptedAt 2026-08-29T15:17:21Z, verdict 'ok', 1 requested / 1 fetched) and it yielded FOUR takes: Obli's n0H4JFE6Suc 'What did the buffs do for Frost DK?' (205 caption chunks, 6m32s, published 2026-08-28T13:20Z), his first raid week on both Death Knights after the August 25 pass. It splits cleanly by bracket, which is why it is four takes and not two - Frost raid NEGATIVE (falls off on long encounters, only okay on the two-target cleave he had expected to be its strength, and his worse-geared Unholy alt out-damaged his 311-ilvl Frost main; he asks for a flat 10-15% sized off his own Hiz'garak log against an Arcane Mage), Frost M+ POSITIVE ('we're actually doing pretty good', roughly level with Unholy, raised as the reason raid tuning must not overshoot), Unholy raid POSITIVE (scales up through long Mythic fights to match meta classes; held back by a Blightfall bug where target damage amplifiers do not apply to its eruption damage, which he says has been live all tier), and Unholy M+ POSITIVE ('very good', a teeny bit ahead of Frost). Both specs are inside his declared Frost/Unholy scope; Blood is not touched. Four prior Obli takes superseded, each within the same lens - Frost raid and Frost M+ from 08-23, Unholy raid and Unholy M+ from 08-25 - and his generalCreators-style 'latest' line was rewritten to what was actually distilled. Declined on the list-mention rule: the Arcane Mage 176k figure and the Marksmanship Hunter comparison are the yardsticks of his own buff arithmetic, not reads on those specs. Queue maintenance: n0H4JFE6Suc removed from videos[] (distilled, so its take url is now its record and no weaker lane may hold it), and 3 new videos appended - Shadarek's s508k-L7ims 'Havoc BUFFED AGAIN! | Sep 1st Class Tuning', Critcake's UfjdyqXGbeM 'SLAYER FURY IS SO BACK' (queued on its description, 'Season 2 4-set acquired. Slayer Fury is back on the menu', which is a placement claim where his 08-28 pug-key video was correctly skipped), and LBNinja7's pdYpGLyZ7VM 'Healers Buffed AGAIN!! | 12.1 Tuning', whose description cites the September 1 blue post and whose creator carries five healer specs across four classes. Seen-set union 1,213; 228 unseen in-cycle videos of which 135 pass the nightly keyword filter, and the 132 not queued stay UNSEEN rather than being written to seen[] - a budget cut is exactly the dismissal class that must remain reconsiderable, and the nightly filter is kept because Supadata's free tier is 100 requests per MONTH. Two deliberate non-queues worth naming: both Supatease items ('12.1 MAJOR Class Changes BIG Update', 'THE NEW META IS COMING') are from the creator the skill names as the PvP-framing trap, and Dalaran Gaming's seRL4jirX9E 'Talent Squish, New Modes, & Huge Patch Roadmap' is a LEAD about future plans that the official lanes do not corroborate - the forum and blue tracker carry no 12.2 PTR announcement tonight. No YouTube or transcript-API request was made by this agent.
